title: Esmeltar Red
summary: Provides 3 Camp Supplies or can be drunk or thrown.

fields.Camp supplies: Provides 3 Camp Supplies for a Long Rest.
fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Drink one bottle. Alcohol gives disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma checks for 2 turns.
fields.Throw: Action. Break the bottle to create a permanent, 13 ft-radius Alcohol surface. The surface is flammable.
fields.Variants: The listed variants provide 1 or 3 Camp Supplies and are worth 1 or 3 gp respectively. The documented spawn UUID produces the 1-supply bottle.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay, acquisition, and pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
